title: Google Antigravity (AGY) Slash Commands Catalog
description: Comprehensive index of built-in and workflow slash commands available across Google Antigravity ecosystem.

commands.summary: Run a long-running, autonomous task until complete.
commands.description: Instructs the agent to relentlessly iterate, run terminal commands, execute tests, catch failures, and verify requirements until the entire goal is met.
commands.when_to_use: Overnight builds, multi-hour refactors, creating 100% test coverage suites.
commands.example: /goal Implement full JWT authentication with refresh tokens and verify test suite passes.

commands.summary: Generate a step-by-step architectural implementation plan before modifying code.
commands.description: Breaks down complex, multi-file features into phased milestones with risk analysis and dependency mapping for human review.
commands.when_to_use: Complex architectural changes, multi-layer features, or high-risk production code modifications.
commands.example: /plan Migrate database schema from SQLite to PostgreSQL with Alembic migrations.

commands.summary: Engage in an interactive Socratic design interview to clarify requirements.
commands.description: Proactively questions assumptions, edge cases, error-handling behaviors, and trade-offs before generating code or specs.
commands.when_to_use: Ambiguous requirements, API design discussions, or tech stack tradeoffs.
commands.example: /grill-me Real-time event streaming pipeline using Redis Streams.

commands.summary: Persist behavioral guidelines or preferences into long-term agent memory.
commands.description: Records project conventions, corrections, or setup fixes to ensure consistent agent behavior across all future sessions.
commands.when_to_use: When correcting an agent mistake or establishing repository conventions.
commands.example: /learn Always run `black` formatting before completing a task and never use global pip packages.

commands.summary: Schedule a recurring cron job or one-shot timer for background notifications.
commands.description: Creates non-blocking background timers or cron schedules that notify the agent to run recurring tasks or health checks.
commands.when_to_use: Monitoring staging deployments, sending delayed reminders, or periodic health checks.
commands.example: /schedule Cron='*/15 * * * *' Prompt='Check staging server health and alert on failure'

commands.summary: Open interactive visual diff viewer for modified files.
commands.description: Presents side-by-side or inline git diffs allowing code inspection, hunk approval, or rejection.
commands.when_to_use: Reviewing code modifications before final acceptance.

commands.summary: Condense and summarize conversation context to free token space.
commands.description: Compacts earlier conversation turns into a dense summary while retaining critical state and goals.
commands.when_to_use: In long-running sessions approaching context window limits.

commands.summary: Reset current conversation context and start a clean session.
commands.description: Clears conversation memory while preserving all workspace files and configurations.
commands.when_to_use: Switching to an unrelated task in the same repository.

commands.summary: Branch the current conversation trajectory into an isolated fork.
commands.description: Clones the conversation history up to the current point, allowing exploration of alternative implementations.
commands.when_to_use: Trying out alternative libraries or algorithms without losing prior work.

commands.summary: Rename the current conversation session.
commands.description: Gives the session a descriptive name for convenient retrieval in project history.
commands.when_to_use: Organizing and archiving multi-task sessions.

commands.summary: Toggle or configure CLI/TUI status line.
commands.description: Shows or hides the status line displaying active model, token counter, and workspace status.
commands.when_to_use: Customizing terminal workspace UI.

commands.summary: Exit the CLI or TUI session.
commands.description: Cleanly closes the interactive agent session (equivalent to Ctrl+D Ctrl+D).
commands.when_to_use: Terminating work in terminal mode.

commands.summary: Switch active LLM or run a prompt with a designated model.
commands.description: Selects between Gemini models (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 3 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite) or routes a single prompt to a specific model.
commands.when_to_use: Switching between fast prototyping and heavy reasoning models.

commands.summary: Configure reasoning and thinking budget.
commands.description: Sets the depth of deliberation and internal chain-of-thought analysis for complex problem-solving.
commands.when_to_use: Dialing up effort for difficult algorithmic bugs or down for simple file edits.

commands.summary: Display real-time quota, rate limits, and context utilization.
commands.description: Shows input/output tokens, cache hits, and remaining quota limits.
commands.when_to_use: Monitoring resource usage during heavy pair programming sessions.

commands.summary: View Google Cloud / G1 credits and account tier.
commands.description: Shows remaining compute credits and tier upgrade options.
commands.when_to_use: Checking credit balances and billing status.

commands.summary: List all active, discovered, and built-in skills.
commands.description: Displays available skills from `.agents/skills/`, global configurations, and system defaults.
commands.when_to_use: Checking what automated runbooks or skills the agent has access to.

commands.summary: List available agent personas and subagents.
commands.description: Displays team personas (@pm, @coder, @qa) and specialized subagents configured in the project.
commands.when_to_use: Selecting or verifying persona configurations in .agents/AGENTS.md.

commands.summary: Manage tool permissions, bash approvals, and sandboxing.
commands.description: Configures command allowlists, denylists, sandbox isolation, and file access policies.
commands.when_to_use: Tightening or loosening terminal auto-execution permissions.

commands.summary: Inspect and manage lifecycle event hooks.
commands.description: Configures automated pre-tool command auditing, formatters, and post-execution hooks.
commands.when_to_use: Enforcing enterprise compliance and logging on agent actions.

commands.summary: Open interactive settings panel.
commands.description: Provides a comprehensive UI to adjust global and workspace settings.
commands.when_to_use: Modifying agent behavior, theme, or workspace configurations.

commands.summary: Manage Model Context Protocol servers and tool integrations.
commands.description: Lists, adds, connects, and configures MCP servers (PostgreSQL, GitHub, AlloyDB, etc.).
commands.when_to_use: Integrating databases or external API services into agent workflows.

commands.summary: Manage remote-control background daemon.
commands.description: Starts or stops the remote-control daemon for headless CLI or external pairing.
commands.when_to_use: Pairing across workstations or managing remote agent daemons.

commands.summary: Show Antigravity release notes and changes.
commands.description: Renders latest features, updates, and improvements to Antigravity.
commands.when_to_use: Checking for new platform features and updates.

commands.summary: Show available commands and keybindings.
commands.description: Displays quick command syntax and keyboard shortcut cheatsheet.
commands.when_to_use: Looking up commands or keybindings inside an active session.
